pages.title: Object Levitation
pages.text: $(o)Grab and move targets; Throw (U) flings them.$()

Channel to grab a creature or dropped item within 12/14/16 blocks and move it with your aim. Uses Iron Telekinesis for creatures. Press Throw (U by default) to throw the target. Costs 25 mana per channel pulse; releases when casting stops.
